cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a skilled assembler to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.
You must have desired technical knowledge and possess great manual dexterity. Ability to interpret instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. And follow them with precision.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Perform repetitive progressive line assembly of parts, and sub-assemblies on any line within the plant, in accordance with predetermined standard work.
Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints.
Detect quality defects and unsafe conditions.
Be knowledgeable, and follow all applicable safety rules and procedures.
Read print drawings to determine dimensions, design, and materials for construction.
Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for performing job duties.
Effectively use measuring devices such as tape measures and levels.
Maintain and inspect tools and equipment, and create work orders for tools/equipment to be repaired as needed.
Loading and unloading onto conveyors and carts, operating fork trucks, and hoists.
Work in a team environment, and assist co-workers in other areas as needed/directed, suggesting process improvement ideas.
Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
Tasks can include but are not limited to: brazing, soldering, operating machines and presses, hanging and unhanging parts, and performing quality checks and tests.
All other duties as assigned by the supervisor/team leader.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED)
Familiar with and ability to utilize all hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding
Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and maintain general understanding of business process
Knowledgeable of and able to utilize computer systems
Preferred Requirements
One (1) year in manufacturing experience
Familiar with and can utilize power tools
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.
You must have desired technical knowledge and possess great manual dexterity. Ability to interpret instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. And follow them with precision.
cond_0129.responsibilities:
Perform repetitive progressive line assembly of parts, and sub-assemblies on any line within the plant, in accordance with predetermined standard work.
Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints.
Detect quality defects and unsafe conditions.
Be knowledgeable, and follow all applicable safety rules and procedures.
Read print drawings to determine dimensions, design, and materials for construction.
Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for performing job duties.
Effectively use measuring devices such as tape measures and levels.
Maintain and inspect tools and equipment, and create work orders for tools/equipment to be repaired as needed.
Loading and unloading onto conveyors and carts, operating fork trucks, and hoists.
Work in a team environment, and assist co-workers in other areas as needed/directed, suggesting process improvement ideas.
Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
Tasks can include but are not limited to: brazing, soldering, operating machines and presses, hanging and unhanging parts, and performing quality checks and tests.
All other duties as assigned by the supervisor/team leader.
cond_0129.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED), or equivalent practical experience.
Some familiarity with hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding.
Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and a general understanding of business process.
Familiarity with power tools.
Basic comfort with computer systems.
Preferred Requirements
Around 1 year of manufacturing experience, though relevant training or coursework is also considered.
Knowledge of and willingness to comply with all general work rules, policies and procedures, including safety guidelines and procedures.
Willingness to learn to operate all equipment associated with the job; including, but not limited to, power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
Ability to identify routine problems and correct them, with openness to learning along the way.
Working knowledge of standard work instructions is helpful but can be developed on the job.
Able to work well with others in a team-oriented manufacturing environment.
Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple tasks.
cond_0129.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.
cond_0129.inclusion: [Company name masked] is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

You will work closely with your team to ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position involves safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards, with regular communication with co-workers and team leaders. Assignments may change based on business demands.
You must have solid technical knowledge and good manual dexterity, and be able to read and follow instructions from manuals, drawings, and schematics with precision.
cond_0195.responsibilities:
Perform repetitive progressive line assembly of parts and sub-assemblies on any line within the plant, in accordance with predetermined standard work.
Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints. Detect quality defects and unsafe conditions.
Stay informed on and follow all applicable safety rules and procedures, and actively raise safety concerns when they arise.
Read print drawings to determine dimensions, design, and materials for construction.
Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for performing job duties.
Effectively use measuring devices such as tape measures and levels.
Maintain and inspect tools and equipment, and create work orders for tools/equipment to be repaired as needed.
Loading and unloading onto conveyors and carts, operating fork trucks, and hoists.
Work closely with your team on a daily basis, assist co-workers in other areas as needed or directed, and actively contribute process improvement ideas.
Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
Tasks can include but are not limited to: brazing, soldering, operating machines and presses, hanging and unhanging parts, and performing quality checks and tests.
All other duties as assigned by the supervisor/team leader.
cond_0195.requirements:
High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED) is required.
One (1) year in manufacturing experience preferred.
Familiar with and ability to utilize all hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding.
Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and maintain general understanding of business process.
Familiar with and can utilize power tools.
Knowledgeable of and able to utilize computer systems.
Knowledge of and willingness to comply with all general work rules, policies and procedures, including safety guidelines and procedures.
Able to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
Ability to learn to operate all equipment associated with the job; including, but not limited to, power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
Ability to identify routine problem causation, correct routine problems, and willingness to learn.
Broad working knowledge and experience with standard work instructions.
Must be able to work well with others in a team setting and communicate regularly with co-workers.
Must possess ability to work well in a manufacturing environment.
Must be detail-oriented and self-motivated.
Must be able to manage multiple tasks in a busy environment.
cond_0195.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0195.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

cond_0219.intro:
We are looking for a skilled assembler to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.
You must have desired technical knowledge and possess great manual dexterity. Ability to interpret instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. And follow them with precision.
cond_0219.responsibilities:
Perform repetitive progressive line assembly of parts, and sub-assemblies on any line within the plant, in accordance with predetermined standard work.
Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints.
Detect quality defects and unsafe conditions.
Be knowledgeable, and follow all applicable safety rules and procedures.
Read print drawings to determine dimensions, design, and materials for construction.
Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for performing job duties.
Effectively use measuring devices such as tape measures and levels.
Maintain and inspect tools and equipment, and create work orders for tools/equipment to be repaired as needed.
Loading and unloading onto conveyors and carts, operating fork trucks, and hoists.
Work in a team environment, and assist co-workers in other areas as needed/directed, suggesting process improvement ideas.
Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
Tasks can include but are not limited to: brazing, soldering, operating machines and presses, hanging and unhanging parts, and performing quality checks and tests.
All other duties as assigned by the supervisor/team leader.
cond_0219.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED), or equivalent practical experience.
Some familiarity with hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding.
Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and a general understanding of business process.
Familiarity with power tools.
Basic comfort with computer systems.
Preferred Requirements
Around 1 year of manufacturing experience, though relevant training or coursework is also considered.
Knowledge of and willingness to comply with all general work rules, policies and procedures, including safety guidelines and procedures.
Willingness to learn to operate all equipment associated with the job; including, but not limited to, power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
Ability to identify routine problems and correct them, with openness to learning along the way.
Working knowledge of standard work instructions is helpful but can be developed on the job.
Able to work well with others in a team-oriented manufacturing environment.
Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple tasks.

cond_0261.intro:
We are looking for a skilled assembler to work alongside our team on the assembly of our product. Together, the team ensures all parts fit correctly and meet quality standards for the final product. This position involves safely performing high-level continuous work in coordination with others, and assignments may shift based on business needs.
You should have solid technical knowledge and good manual dexterity, along with the ability to read and follow instructions from manuals, drawings, and schematics.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Work with others on repetitive progressive line assembly of parts and sub-assemblies on any line within the plant, following predetermined standard work.
Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints together with your team.
Help identify quality defects and unsafe conditions and flag them appropriately.
Follow all applicable safety rules and procedures and support others in doing the same.
Read print drawings to determine dimensions, design, and materials for construction.
Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for the job.
Work alongside teammates using measuring devices such as tape measures and levels.
Maintain and inspect tools and equipment, and coordinate work orders for repairs as needed.
Assist with loading and unloading onto conveyors and carts, and support operation of fork trucks and hoists.
Work as part of a team, help co-workers in other areas as needed, and share process improvement ideas.
Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
Tasks may include brazing, soldering, operating machines and presses, hanging and unhanging parts, and carrying out quality checks and tests in coordination with the team.
All other duties as assigned by the supervisor/team leader.
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or GED
Familiar with and able to use hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding
Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and maintain a general understanding of business process
Familiar with and able to use power tools
Able to use computer systems
Preferred Requirements
1 Year of manufacturing experience

cond_0337.intro:
We are looking for a skilled assembler to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.
You must have desired technical knowledge and possess great manual dexterity. Ability to interpret instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. And follow them with precision. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of assembly processes and technical instructions.
cond_0337.responsibilities:
Perform repetitive progressive line assembly of parts, and sub-assemblies on any line within the plant, in accordance with predetermined standard work.
Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints. Detect quality defects and unsafe conditions.
Be knowledgeable, and follow all applicable safety rules and procedures.
Read print drawings to determine dimensions, design, and materials for construction.
Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for performing job duties.
Effectively use measuring devices such as tape measures and levels.
Maintain and inspect tools and equipment, and create work orders for tools/equipment to be repaired as needed.
Loading and unloading onto conveyors and carts, operating fork trucks, and hoists.
Work in a team environment, and assist co-workers in other areas as needed/directed, suggesting process improvement ideas.
Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
Tasks can include but are not limited to: brazing, soldering, operating machines and presses, hanging and unhanging parts, and performing quality checks and tests.
All other duties as assigned by the supervisor/team leader.
cond_0337.requirements:
High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED) is required.
One (1) year in manufacturing experience preferred.
Familiar with and ability to utilize all hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding.
Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and maintain general understanding of business process.
Familiar with and can utilize power tools.
Knowledgeable of and able to utilize computer systems.
Knowledge of and willingness to comply with all general work rules, policies and procedures, including safety guidelines and procedures.
Able to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
Ability to learn to operate all equipment associated with the job; including, but not limited to, power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
Ability to identify routine problem causation, and correct routine problems, and willingness to learn.
Broad working knowledge and experience with standard work instructions.
Team oriented, must have the ability to work cohesively with others.
Must possess ability to work well in a manufacturing environment.
Must be detail-oriented and self-motivated.
Must be able to work in a fast-paced, multi-tasked environment.

cond_0370.intro:
We are looking for a skilled assembler to perform a variety of tasks as assigned in conjunction with the assembly of our product. You will ensure all parts fit correctly and are suitable for the final product. This position is responsible for safely performing high-level continuous work to quality standards. Assignments may change based on business demands.
You must have desired technical knowledge and possess great manual dexterity. Ability to interpret instructions represented in manuals, drawings, schematics etc. And follow them with precision.
cond_0370.responsibilities:
Perform repetitive progressive line assembly of parts, and sub-assemblies on any line within the plant, in accordance with predetermined standard work.
Read, understand, and apply method sheets, assembly diagrams, and blueprints. Detect quality defects and unsafe conditions.
Be knowledgeable, and follow all applicable safety rules and procedures.
Read print drawings to determine dimensions, design, and materials for construction.
Operate power pneumatic and hand tools required for performing job duties.
Effectively use measuring devices such as tape measures and levels.
Maintain and inspect tools and equipment, and create work orders for tools/equipment to be repaired as needed.
Loading and unloading onto conveyors and carts, operating fork trucks, and hoists.
Work in a team environment, and assist co-workers in other areas as needed/directed, suggesting process improvement ideas.
Perform general housekeeping of the work area.
Tasks can include but are not limited to: brazing, soldering, operating machines and presses, hanging and unhanging parts, and performing quality checks and tests.
All other duties as assigned by the supervisor/team leader.
cond_0370.requirements:
High School Diploma or General Equivalent Diploma (GED) is required.
One (1) year in manufacturing experience preferred.
Familiar with and ability to utilize all hand tools including wrenches, sockets, hammers, tape measures, crimpers, cutters, and steel banding.
Basic mechanical aptitude to use equipment and maintain general understanding of business process.
Familiar with and can utilize power tools.
Knowledgeable of and able to utilize computer systems.
Knowledge of and willingness to comply with all general work rules, policies and procedures, including safety guidelines and procedures.
Able to rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
Ability to learn to operate all equipment associated with the job; including, but not limited to, power hand tools, forklifts, skyjacks, cranes, and measuring devices.
Ability to identify routine problem causation, and correct routine problems, and willingness to learn.
Broad working knowledge and experience with standard work instructions.
Team oriented, must have the ability to work cohesively with others.
Must possess ability to work well in a manufacturing environment.
Must be detail-oriented and self-motivated.
